name: Monster picker text
notes: Shown while the monster is in the cave choosing another one (prop_picker): the yellow arrows on both sides of the monster's portrait (Left / Right browse), the monster's name under it in the menus' white letters and, on the line below, its type ('TYPE: WATER') in the thin gold info letters of the menu map's bottom line (font_info, drawn as sprites). Nothing else: no best time, no PRESS START.
